requirements: AMD GPU supported by the ROCm version bundled in the official asset
rocminfo working for the user, not merely an amdgpu display driver
hardware.notes: Official ROCm 10.0 llama.cpp builds. A newer ROCm asset can drop older GPUs (pre-RDNA parts often need an older HIP build). Black Mirror will not install ROCm system packages. If rocminfo is missing, status stays experimental/unconfirmed. Mixed NVIDIA+AMD boxes cannot share one llama.cpp process — pick CUDA or ROCm, not both.
